VII, 14</cite> <he>בזמן שיש בו ס׳</he> when he has a scratch (on the skin, whereby the poison might be communicated to the blood); <cite ref="Avodah Zarah 30b:8">Ab. Zar. 30ᵇ</cite> <he>מקום שיש ס׳</he>; <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Terumot 8:3:17">Y. Ter. VIII, 45ᵈ</cite> top <he>מקום ס׳</he>.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Terumot 8:3:17">Ib.</cite> <he>פניו כס׳ הם</he> a man’s face is as susceptible of poison as a scratched spot.
